title: Compactification proper compositor and forget-supports calculation
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, p:W→X and f:X→S proper maps, d=(i_d,g_d) any compactification of f, and e any compactification of p;i_d. The pullback construction e.restrict compactifies p, while d.comp e compactifies p;f. For every E in the ordinary unbounded D(W_et,A), the compatible-model compositor from R p_!(e.restrict) followed by R f_!(d) to R(p;f)_!(d.comp e), followed by the forget-supports map for d.comp e, equals the following route: apply R f_!(d) to the forget-supports map for e.restrict, apply the forget-supports map for d to R p_* E, and apply the canonical ordinary direct-image compositor R p_* R f_* → R(p;f)_*. All compactification forget-supports maps are the open comparison D(i_!)→Ri_* followed by the ordinary direct-image compositor. There are no comparisons between different compactifications in this equation.

source.place: First triangle, common pullback counits, restricted to the compatible compactification tower before the independence comparisons.

proof.text: Write J_a=D(a_!) for an open immersion a, t_a:J_a→Ra_* for the adjunct of the inverse open unit, and κ for ordinary direct-image composition. Expand rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationCompIso: first exchange J_(d.i) with R(e.restrict.g)_*, then compose the two open extensions, and compose the two proper pushforwards. The underlying pullback square is e.isPullback_restrict, and its open factor identity is e.restrict_i_fst.

The open/proper exchange followed by the forget-supports map on its target equals the forget-supports map on its source followed by the ordinary direct-image comparison of the square. To check this equation, transpose under the pullback/direct-image adjunction for e.g. The unit and counit in the definition of exchange cancel by the triangle identity. The remaining equation is derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekBaseChangeIso_hom_comp_toLowerStar, which follows from the unit-mate equation of the cited node. Transpose back, obtaining the required exchange square.

For two composable open immersions a,b, the inverse open-extension compositor followed by t_(a;b) equals J_b(t_a), then t_b on Ra_*E, then κ_(a,b). Transpose under the composite pullback/direct-image adjunction. By uniqueness of left adjoints, the open-extension compositor transports the composite open-adjunction unit to the unit for a;b. Thus both transposes are its inverse. This is the composite counit and triangle calculation; it also respects the equality e.restrict.i;pullback.fst e.g d.i=e.i.

Substitute the two preceding squares into the expanded compatible-model compositor. Move forget-supports maps through the ordinary direct-image compositors by naturality. Associativity of κ combines the proper factors e.g and d.g with the open factors, leaving precisely the compositor for p followed by f. The commutativity equations of d, e.restrict and d.comp e identify all composite morphisms with p, f and p;f. This gives the displayed equation without any chosen-compactification comparison.

theorem properShriekComp_compactificationForgetSupports {W X S : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : W ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper p] [IsProper f]
    (d : Compactification f) (e : Compactification (p ≫ d.i))
    (E : DerivedCategoryModule A W) :
    (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationCompIso A d e).hom.app E ≫
        (compactificationForgetSupports (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (d.comp e)).app E =
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d).map
          ((compactificationForgetSupports (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e.restrict).app E) ≫
        (compactificationForgetSupports (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d).app
          ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj E) ≫
        (rightDerivedLowerStarCompIsoOfComp
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) p f (p ≫ f) rfl).hom.app E
